section_summary.extract_value: This is a limitations section of a study examining the relationship between interpersonal interactions and body image using a daily diary methodology over one week. The study measured exposure to 'body focused' and 'non-body focused' others and their effects on body image and eating behaviors. Key limitations include the correlational nature of the data, unvalidated scales with limited items, short study duration (one week), and constraints of daily diary methodology that prevented assessment of momentary experiences and detailed interaction characteristics.
